{{Quote|And back again is the mighty Dud Bolt with that incredible machine—the Vulptereen 327!|Fode, a podrace commentator|audio=Fode-DudBolt-TPM.flac|<ref name="TPM" />}}
The '''Vulptereen 327''' was a [[podracer]] that the [[Podracer (profession)|podracer]] [[pilot]] [[Dud Bolt]] used for multiple [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|races]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]].

==History==
During the [[Invasion of Naboo]], the [[Podracer (profession)|podracer]] [[Dud Bolt]] piloted his Vulptereen 327 in yet another [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|race]]. Bolt started in the second row, but fell behind quickly when the race began. The [[human]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] won the Boonta.<ref name="TPM" /> He later used the [[podracer]] on an [[Water|ice]]-covered location, shortly before the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> Bolt's Vulptereen 327 was predominantly [[Color|red]], although the paint was scratched off and damaged in many areas on the [[engine]] units. The front end of both engines was a dull gray.<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vulptereen 327 first appeared in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="TPM" /> and later briefly appeared in its sequel, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="aotc" /> Both films were directed by [[George Lucas]].<ref name="TPM" /><ref name="aotc" />

In early sketches of the podracer's design, the engines were reversed.<ref name="DB">{{DB|vehicle|dudboltspodracer|Podracer, Dud Bolt's}}</ref> This reversed appearance carried over into early animatics of the podracing sequence.<ref name="TPMDVD">{{Film|I}} [[Star Wars home video releases|DVD special features]]</ref>
